item.text: {"text":"Focus component: model_design. Use Tier 2 architectural deepening by adding content-dependent gating inside the existing causal dilated-convolution NextItNet blocks. The latest validation HR@10 of 0.645 remains below the best 0.650, so the next experiment should test a new representation mechanism rather than another hyperparameter adjustment. The hypothesis is that unconditional GELU transformations propagate irrelevant historical signals, while learned gates could selectively retain useful item transitions.\n\nMake one atomic change: replace each block’s first convolution and GELU activation with a gated convolution. Increase that convolution’s output width from H to 2H, split its output into equal feature and gate tensors, and combine them as features multiplied by sigmoid(gates). Preserve left-only causal padding, dilation schedules, the second convolution, normalization, dropout, learned residual scales, embedding sharing, and all public interfaces. This keeps the model entirely within the permitted NextItNet architecture while allowing each channel and sequence position to control which contextual features enter the residual update. Keep all eight constants and the frozen host configuration unchanged, and use one candidate slot for this controlled experiment. Compare the host-reported validation HR@10 against the 0.650 incumbent and retain the gated architecture only if it improves that selection metric."}
